definitions.commits: Default-branch commits with author_date in the UTC quarter, including merges and bots. Deduplicate SHA globally; attribute shared public/private SHA to public. Counts use the frozen inventory and source snapshot, not current API results.
definitions.pull_requests: PRs created_at in the UTC quarter across 57 public non-fork repositories; includes bot PRs. This is a manually frozen disclosure count, not an automated live PR pipeline.
definitions.unique_authors_excluding_bots: Unique GitHub author accounts across the counted public PRs, excluding bots; accounts are not a count of people.
definitions.external_prs: Counted public PRs by non-bot authors outside the frozen memberships of MosslandOpenDevs and MosslandCore and the mossland account. Private membership visibility limits public reproducibility.
definitions.privacy: Private repositories are represented only by aggregate repository and commit counts. No private repository names, account identifiers, or source rows are published in this artifact.
definitions.rolling_reference: The existing dashboard rolling statistics use a separate fixed repository list and GitHub rolling statistical windows. They do not share this quarterly population or date basis and must not be substituted for these Q3 values.

provenance.artifact_hash: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes is supplied in development-data.json.sha256; source hashes above identify the frozen inputs.
